sv.title: Ramlösa säljer del i fraktfartyg
sv.summary: Ramlösa Shipping har ingått avtal om att sälja sitt innehav, motsvarande 7,5 procent, i tankfartyget Chemtrans Mobile till Beteiligungsgesellschaft Krämer.

en.title: Ramlösa sells stake in cargo ship
en.summary: Ramlösa Shipping has entered into an agreement to sell its holding, equivalent to 7.5 percent, in the tanker Chemtrans Mobile to Beteiligungsgesellschaft Krämer.
